build.why: The production script cleans generated caches/output before building and preparing the offline bundle, so a prior instrumented QA build cannot leak into production.

test.why: The repository's node:test suites (`node --test tests/*.test.cjs`, the same files `npm test` runs), through the `test:report` script so one run also writes a JUnit file `nen shu test-report` parses and an lcov capture byakugan reads with --from-capture. Three suites read the built `public/` art, so `build` runs before `test` (CI and the iteration loop both do). Set at Hatsu bootstrap, 2026-10-23.

ui-test.unsupported: Browser UI scenarios run through Codex CUA on the explicit browser lane; use --lane browser after recording that session. The default CLI lane does not drive a browser.

lint.unsupported: PROPOSED SEAT -- replace it. nen shu detect wrote this row because the reference pack proposes no command for 'lint' on gatsby; nen never invents one. The pack's own reason: NO LINTER OF ANY KIND EXISTS IN THIS REPOSITORY.

release.unsupported: PROPOSED SEAT -- replace it. nen shu detect wrote this row because the reference pack proposes no command for 'release' on gatsby; nen never invents one. The pack's own reason: No release lane of any kind.

dev.why: The repository's own develop script: `gatsby develop -H 0.0.0.0 -p 8000`.

run.why: The repository's own start script: `node scripts/serve.cjs`, which serves the production build and so requires a prior `build`.

coverage.why: Read the coverage artifact captured by the declared test run. Measurement never reruns tests; Nen verifies capture provenance with --from-capture.

build.why: Opt-in Istanbul build with synthetic test-only fixtures and coverage export controls; never the ordinary production build.

test.why: Validate and extract the actual successful CUA browser scenario capture from this exact instrumented build. Drive the committed CUA scenario before this artifact verification; this command does not drive a browser or invent execution.

ui-test.why: Read the successful CUA-run browser scenario, verify source/build provenance, and emit its JUnit and coverage results. Requires the Codex browser session capture; no unattended browser runner is claimed.

coverage.why: Read only the coverage artifact already captured and validated by the browser test lane.

run.why: Isolated coverage-build preview with synthetic data. Uses a separate origin from the user wardrobe at port8000.

node.why: The automated tests execute the generated TypeScript trailer publisher directly. Node 22.18 enables type stripping by default; CI uses Node 22, and the publisher workflow explicitly uses Node 24. Verify-only; Nen never installs Node. https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v22.x/api/typescript.html

gatsby.why: Dependencies installed (`npm ci --legacy-peer-deps`, as README states). Nen asserts this and never installs them; CI installs them in its own step.
